### Synaptics Coralboard™ Overview


Synaptics, in partnership with Google Research, brings the next generation of the Google Coral Edge AI platform to life with the Coralboard portfolio. Built for ultra-low power, always-on applications using ambient sensing, the Coralboard is designed to deliver efficient, accelerated on-device inference for resource-constrained form factors.


Create multimodal experiences leveraging the power of open source software and AI tooling, with the first in the line of the series, the Synaptics Coralboard SL.


Now available through[DigiKey's global distribution network](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/synaptics-coralboard/720-KDVSL2619-11/29784108) .

## Coralboard at Google I/O 2026


Tiny Footprint, Outsized Impact


###


A Yolo object detection model accelerated by the Torq NPU on the Coralboard delivers live coordinates of jellyfish movements from the Monterey Bay Aquarium as input to a Google DeepMind Lyria 3 music model, resulting in an immersive generative AI audio experience.


[View Demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nG1bDAcJY9w&feature=youtu.be)

Each version widens what can run at the Edge without asking developers to start over.”

Director, Google Research
